caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic mug, rendered in grayscale pencil or graphite. The mug is cylindrical with a wider base than the mouth, and it features three horizontal bands with raised areas close to the top and bottom. The handle is an elegant, curved loop, attached at the upper edge and lower side of the mug with a small rounded connection at the lower end. The shiny surface shows subtle shading to indicate reflections and highlights on the metal. The composition is centered and isolated on a plain, light-colored background with no other objects or patterns present. There is a small, neat signature in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Silver Mug
